name: Best Buy's Mario Day Digital Signage
description: Every March 10th, Nintendo celebrates MAR10 Day with special offers. For Best Buy Canada, the challenge was standing out in a crowd playing with the exact same cards.

modules.content:
CHALLENGE

When every competitor receives the exact same Nintendo files, how do you make Best Buy Canada's version the one people actually stop for?

SOLUTION

Subtle motion graphics breathed life into the static Nintendo files, eye-catching without overpowering the brand. Best Buy Canada's promo templates were seamless and bilingual specs were tailored individually for each store location.
